name: 478-probe-refused-read-command-not-run
note: #478: a consumer replay of release candidate 2: the plugin-version read probe copy was refused by probe-run (exit -1, empty-output digest, a refused: cmd digest), nothing ran. The run ends provision-failed with probeReason command-not-run, not cmd-mismatch. The engine retries a read probe once with a fresh agent (#486): the second answer repeats the recorded failure (no raw capture of a retry exists; the next canary run replaces it).

args.brief: a refused read copy must be named command-not-run, not cmd-mismatch
